components.name: Diagram/Node
components.description: Flowchart shapes for process docs, bank workflows and onboarding maps. Terminal = start/end (fill/inverse pill), Process = step (surface/card + Elevation/1), Decision = yes/no (accent/soft diamond), Data = document or input (status/info/soft), Subprocess = linked flow (side rules), Note = comment (status/warning/soft). Width 160 on an 8 pt grid, min 32 between nodes, flow left→right or top→bottom.
